title: Surrey and Specialty Cycle Rentals at Point Ruston
includes: Surrey or Specialty Cycle Rental of your Choice
Helmets for all riders (required for all riders under 18 years of age)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Make your day at the Puget Sound waterfront unforgettable with Surrey and Specialty Cycle Rentals from Wheel Fun Rentals at Point Ruston in Tacoma. These playful, easy-to-ride cycles transform a simple stroll into a shared adventure, letting everyone cruise together while enjoying sweeping water views, fresh sea air, and lively waterfront energy. Perfect for families, groups of friends, or a unique date idea, Surrey cycles encourage connection, conversation, and plenty of laughs along the scenic promenade.

With options ranging from multi-passenger Surreys to fun specialty bikes, everyone can join in at their own pace—pedal together, explore local shops, stop for a treat, or simply soak in the beauty of the South Puget Sound. It’s an active, memorable outing that blends sightseeing, relaxation, and just the right amount of adventure.
